title: Binance Launches AI Agent Skills, Powering Every Agent with a Binance-Grade Brain
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,  Binance and Binance Wallet are excited to launch their first batch of  7 AI Agent Skills , empowering any AI Agent with Binance-grade market insights, order execution, and security capabilities. Through a unified interface, AI Agents can now access structured data and trading infrastructure across Binance Wallet and Binance Spot, transforming fragmented crypto signals into actionable intelligence. 7 New AI Agent Skills: Binance Spot Skill:  Access real-time market data (exchange Info, ticker/price, depth, candlesticks), execute orders (supports all order types, including OCO, OPO, and OTOCO), and manage them (cancellation, modification).  Query Address Info:  Analyze any wallet address to generate holdings breakdown, valuation, 24-hour changes, and concentration insights. Ideal for  smart money monitoring , whale tracking, and automated wallet reports. Query Token Info:  Instantly retrieve token meta data, including symbol, chain, price, liquidity, holders, and trading activities. Crypto Market Rank:  Aggregated rankings across trends, hot searches, inflow, meme narratives, and trader PnL. It also provides a structured “what to watch today” prioritization. Meme Rush:  Track meme tokens across lifecycle stages (newly launched, migrating, migrated) and map narrative themes to structured token lists. Trading Signal:  Monitor smart money buy/sell signals with trigger price, current price, maxGain, exitRate, and signal status. Query Token Audit:  Automatically detect common contract risk factors, such as mintability, freeze functions, and ownership privileges. Try it Now Key Features: Unified Intelligence Core:  A single Binance-grade brain powering both wallet analytics and centralized exchange trading. Agents can detect opportunities and execute orders instantly. Seamless Experience:  A complete workflow with no tool switching required.  Smart Money + Security Dual Engine:  Combine smart money signals with automated contract audits, balancing execution speed with built-in risk control. Builder-Friendly:  Skills are fully open and modular. Any Agent framework can integrate Binance-grade intelligence in just a few lines of configuration. About AI Agent Skills: AI Agent Skills are modular capability packages that allow AI Agents (such as OpenClaw, Claude, and others) to access real market data, analytics, risk controls, and trading infrastructure through standardized interfaces. Instead of scraping fragmented sources, Agents can directly plug into Binance-powered intelligence and execution systems.
